# README.md

Source: https://github.com/daanheskes/osrs-idle-clicker/blob/master/README.md

﻿## OSRS Idle Clicker
 

An incremental game based on the game [Old School Runescape](https://oldschool.runescape.com/).

## Contributing
Pull requests are welcome. For major changes, please open an issue first to discuss what you would like to change.

Please make sure to update tests as appropriate

All images and copyrights belong to their original owners. No copyright infringement intended.

# Contributing

When contributing to this repository, please first discuss the change you wish to make via an issue with the owner(s) of this repository before making a change. 

Please note we have a code of conduct, please follow it in all your interactions with the project.
